posts.name: Donald Trump
posts.text: A Huge Victory against Fake News BBC, a terrible abuser of the truth, just handed down by highly respected District Court Judge, Jeffrey T. Kuntz, of the Southern District of Florida. In his powerful ruling, Judge Kuntz wrote, “Here, the news entity created the story. BBC admitted as much by confirming it had edited a video to make it appear as though President Trump made a statement he never made.” We will continue fighting against, and defeating, all of those who try to deceive the American People! Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP

posts.name: Donald Trump
posts.text: I am pleased to nominate Grayson Lambert to serve as Judge on the United States District Court for the District of South Carolina. Grayson is currently Chief Legal Counsel to Governor Henry McMaster and, previously, was a partner at a respected law firm, and clerked for Judge Dennis Shedd of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit. A proud graduate of the University of Virginia and Duke University School of Law, Grayson will be an excellent addition to the Federal Bench in South Carolina. Congratulations Grayson! President DONALD J. TRUMP
posts.text_ko: 저는 Grayson Lambert를 사우스 캐롤라이나 지역 미국 지방 법원의 판사로 지명하게 된 것을 기쁘게 생각합니다. Grayson은 현재 Henry McMaster 주지사의 최고 법률 고문으로 재직하고 있으며, 이전에는 존경받는 법률 회사의 파트너였으며 미국 제4 순회 항소 법원의 Dennis Shedd 판사를 위해 서기로 일했습니다. 버지니아 대학교와 듀크 대학교 로스쿨을 졸업한 것을 자랑스럽게 생각하는 Grayson은 사우스 캐롤라이나의 연방 의원으로 훌륭한 보좌관이 될 것입니다. 축하해요 그레이슨! 도널드 J. 트럼프 대통령
